Name: CHR_EQUIP_MODEL_PARAM_ST
Description: Ray-tracing settings for equipment models worn by characters. A row is matched by its Equipment Model Type, Body Type and Equipment Model ID fields, not by its row ID; when several rows match the same model, the highest row ID wins. No matching row: registered for ray tracing with default culling and BLAS settings.

Fields.Name: Equipment Model Type
Fields.Description: Kind of model the row applies to. 0: weapon. 1: arms. 2: body. 3: head. 4: legs. 5: any armor piece (used when no row exists for the piece's own type). Retail: 0 on all rows.

Fields.Name: Equipment Model Body Type
Fields.Description: 0: both body types (used when no body-type row matches). 1 or 2: one body type only; used only for equipment whose model differs per body type (Equipment Model Gender 1-3). Retail: 0 on all rows.

Fields.Name: Exclude from Ray Tracing
Fields.Description: 1: the model is not registered in the ray-tracing scene.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Culling Mode
Fields.Description: Culling mode used for the model in ray tracing. 0: default.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing BLAS Rebuild Type
Fields.Description: How the model's ray-tracing geometry (BLAS) is rebuilt. 0: default. Retail: 4 on all rows (whips and other flexible weapons).

Fields.Name: Equipment Model ID
Fields.Description: Equipment Model ID of the weapon or armor piece (its equipModelId in EquipParamWeapon or EquipParamProtector).
